### MSS-Login CivitAI Downloader Workflow

Download models directly into your ComfyUI server from CivitAI remotely (compatible with desktop ComfyUI and Comfy Portal mobile app).

**Prerequisites & Privileges:**
- **Download Permission:** Requires the `can_download_models` role permission.
- **CivitAI API Token:**
  - *Profile Token (Recommended):* Save your CivitAI API key in your MSS-Login user profile under **Settings ⚙️ → MSS-Login → Model Download → API Keys** (stored encrypted at rest in the database).
  - *Node Token:* Alternatively, enter your API token directly into the `api_key` field on this node. It will be used for the download and automatically saved to your profile if you don't already have one configured.
  - *Server Fallback:* If a system-wide `CIVITAI_TOKEN` is configured by the server administrator, it will be used automatically when no user key is set.

**How to use:**
1. **Option A (URL):** Paste any CivitAI model URL (e.g. `https://civitai.com/models/12345?modelVersionId=67890`) into `url`.
2. **Option B (Model Version ID):** Enter the numerical `model_version_id`.
3. **Folder Type:** Select target folder (`checkpoints`, `loras`, `vae`, `controlnet`, `unet`, `upscale_models`, etc.).
4. **Save As (Optional):** Custom filename to save the model.
5. **Model Isolation Toggle:**
   - `true` (Private): Saved into your private isolated model folder (`DATA_DIR/model_isolation/...`) with automatic private ACL grant.
   - `false` (Shared): Saved into the shared global models library (`models/...`). Requires `can_manage_model_sharing` or view-all permissions; regular users are restricted to private isolation.

Click **Queue / Generate** to start the download. Progress will stream in real time over WebSocket!
